name: Novel Tool & Algorithm Creator
description: Creates new tools, utilities, middleware, and algorithms for the DoctaRx platform. Uses state-of-the-art patterns and novel approaches to solve unique telehealth challenges.

steps.description: Identify gaps in the current toolset and areas needing new utilities
Design the tool architecture using novel algorithms
steps.prompt_template:
Design a new {{tool_type}} for the DoctaRx telehealth platform.

Requirements: {{requirements}}

Use these novel approaches:
1. Adaptive algorithms that learn from usage patterns
2. Zero-allocation hot paths for real-time operations
3. Probabilistic data structures (bloom filters, HyperLogLog) where applicable
4. Event-driven architecture with backpressure support
5. Self-healing patterns with automatic degradation

Generate complete production code with:
- Full JSDoc documentation
- Error handling for all edge cases
- Performance benchmarks in comments
- Integration examples
- Configuration options

steps.description: Create the tool file with full implementation
Create API routes if the tool needs HTTP access
Wire the new tool into the application
Run the tool in sandbox to verify it works

novel_tool_ideas: Adaptive Query Optimizer — learns from PostgreSQL query patterns to suggest index creation and query rewrites
Smart Session Manager — uses behavioral clustering to predict session expiry and pre-emptively refresh
HIPAA Compliance Scanner — static analysis tool that scans code for PHI exposure risks
Real-time Anomaly Detector — streaming algorithm using Robust Random Cut Forest for detecting unusual API patterns
Self-Documenting API — automatically generates OpenAPI spec from Express routes and JSDoc
Intelligent Load Balancer — request routing based on predicted response time using lightweight regression
Automated Schema Migrator — detects model changes and generates migration SQL automatically
